title: QP2506 q2's source map said the Net-Zero Framework was 'not adopted until four months after' the sitting. It has still not been adopted. RC-04.
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Lane-B audit D01-S01, RC-04.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD, and narrowly. The defect is one clause of the source map making a claim about the FUTURE of the sitting. A past paper may be wrong about what happened next without being wrong about its own sitting, so the sitting-anchored answer and its flashcard - which already say 'circulated but not adopted' - are correct and were not touched.
authority: HELD - known_traps.md #30, which records the MEPC/ES.2 adjournment and instructs that this Framework is never to be stated as adopted, in force, or on a fixed future date without a fresh check against the current MEPC session. SECONDARY - MEPC 83 approval April 2025; IMO Circular Letter No.5005 of 11 April 2025 under MARPOL art.16(2)(a); MEPC/ES.2 of 14-17 October 2025 adjourned for one year; MEPC 84 of April-May 2026 reached no final agreement.
